headline: Record quarter as fee growth and buybacks lift EPS
summary_short: BNY's Q2 2026 diluted EPS rose 27% y/y to $2.45 as net income attributable to BNY grew 23.8% y/y to $1,761M, total revenue increased 13% to $5.7B, and ROTCE reached 31.3%.
summary_long: Revenue grew 13% y/y to $5.698B (fee revenue +11%, net interest income +20% on reinvestment at higher yields) against 7% expense growth, plus an $8M credit-loss benefit, driving diluted EPS up 27% y/y to $2.45. ROTCE hit 31.3%, pre-tax margin 39.8%, with 606bps of positive operating leverage y/y. CET1 ratio held flat at 11.0%; total cash rose 31% y/y to $7,483M while long-term debt fell 9% to $30,368M. BNY returned $1.5B to shareholders ($1.1B buybacks, $371M dividends), an 87% year-to-date payout ratio, and diluted share count fell 3.9% y/y on repurchases. No explicit forward guidance was issued in this release.
